ranking_policy: Security-technique scan for mini-ork, a task OS for coding agents that ships code it writes (recipe DAGs of LLM + deterministic verifier nodes, a publish gate, a worktree merge gate, sandboxed places to run, and a secrets vault). mini-ork's security posture is FAIL-CLOSED and EVIDENCE-ANCHORED: a guard that cannot measure blocks, an unverified result is an abstention, and no change is promoted on a model's opinion. Rank 2026 papers by how directly their SECURITY technique could be adopted by one of mini-ork's surfaces: vulnerability discovery in code an agent wrote or is about to merge (SAST/taint, LLM review, CWE detection), red teaming and exploit generation used AS a verification signal, prompt injection and untrusted-content handling for agents that read repos and tool output, sandboxing and capability restriction (filesystem, shell, network egress, tool allowlists), supply-chain and secret leakage detection, secure code generation and vulnerability repair, patch verification by reproduction, agent audit trails, and benchmark validity for security claims. Papers that build or measure the DETECTOR itself (precision/recall on real code, false-positive cost, adversarial evasion) rank above papers whose security is a side experiment; papers matched by multiple topics rank above single-topic matches; break ties by citation signal (citation_count, influential_citation_count) and recency.
